# Sanskriti Srivastava

> Product and program manager. Helping great ideas meet great execution.

Sanskriti is an Associate Product Manager at AlgoZenith Technologies, working on CareerZenith.ai, an AI resume builder. She previously ran AlgoZenith's Campus Connection Program across 100+ colleges with 1,200+ student members. B.Tech in Information Technology (2026, CGPA 8.26) from Shri Ramswaroop Memorial College of Engineering and Management, Lucknow.

Open to full-time roles in product management, project and program management, and founder's office.
